title: Truecaller takes its scam intelligence to the open web as it looks beyond caller ID | TechCrunch
summary: The Swedish company on Sunday launched Scam Checker , a new web and Android service that lets users paste in a suspicious phone number, link, or message to find out if it’s fraudulent.
